blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – The elite Special Action Force (SAF) of the Philippine National Police (PNP) has retained a battalion, composed of 500 troops, in Maguindanao del Sur to help in the government’s drive to disband Islamic State-aligned groups sowing terror in the province. Col. John Michael Mangahis, Maguindanao del Sur police provincial director, said Monday the PNP-SAF deployment will greatly enhance the provincial police command’s security operations across the province’s 24 municipalities, particularly in the lairs of the terrorists Bangsamoro Islamic Freedom Fighters (BIFF) and Dawlah Islamiyah (DI). “With 500 elite troopers and light armor vehicle support, the SAF’s presence ensures […]...
